text:
<emotion>upset</emotion>Kwame gripped the edge of the plastic chair, his knuckles white. He stared at the blood-stained gauze draped over the golden retriever’s paw, a sharp sob catching in his throat as he wiped his eyes with the back of a trembling hand. He paced a tight circle, kicking at the leg of a side table and letting out a ragged, shuddering breath.

The automatic glass door slid open with a loud hiss. 

<emotion>unsettled</emotion>Kwame froze, glancing at the flickering fluorescent light above that hummed in a dissonant, erratic frequency. He shifted his weight, noticing the way the air in the clinic suddenly smelled of ozone and old bleach. The receptionist’s smile didn't reach her eyes, and the sudden, heavy silence of the other waiting patrons made the hair on his arms stand up.

A vet in green scrubs stepped into the hall and beamed.

<emotion>cheerful</emotion>Kwame leaped to his feet, a wide grin splitting his face. He clapped his hands together and let out a loud, bright laugh that echoed off the tiled walls. He bounced on his heels, whistling a quick tune while he gathered the dog’s leash with an energetic flick of his wrist.
